blocks.title: Velocity from positions
blocks.problem: A cart is at 0, 1.2, 4.9, 11.1 m at t = 0, 1, 2, 3 s. Estimate the velocity at t = 1 s and t = 2 s with central differences.

blocks.title: How the error depends on h
blocks.md:
For $f(x) = e^x$ at $x = 1$ (true derivative $e$), print h, the forward error % and the central error % for
h = 0.1, 0.01, 0.001, rounded to 5 decimals. Expected output:

```text
0.1 5.17092 0.16675
0.01 0.50167 0.00167
0.001 0.05002 2e-05
```

items: Compute the three differences by hand.
Apply the trapezoid rule by hand and in code.

blocks.title: Solution: How the error depends on h
blocks.md:
Full program for **How the error depends on h** (try it yourself first):

```python
import numpy as np

f = lambda x: np.exp(x)
x, true = 1, np.e
for h in [0.1, 0.01, 0.001]:
    fwd = (f(x + h) - f(x)) / h
    cen = (f(x + h) - f(x - h)) / (2 * h)
    e_fwd = abs(fwd - true) / true * 100
    e_cen = abs(cen - true) / true * 100
    print(h, round(e_fwd, 5), round(e_cen, 5))
```

Output:

```text
0.1 5.17092 0.16675
0.01 0.50167 0.00167
0.001 0.05002 2e-05
```
